description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Holding priority, activate Tyvar by paying {3}{G}{G}, giving creatures you control +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the greatest power among creatures you control.
If you do not control a creature with power 19 or greater, repeat from step 2.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.
